papers.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
papers.translated_title: LIBERO-PeRM：个性化机器人操作基准测试
papers.author: Zhixu Li
papers.summary: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.
papers.translated_summary: 个性化对于通用机器人进入家庭环境并实现真正的实用性至关重要。尽管通用机器人操作已被广泛研究，但个性化机器人操作（PeRM）缺乏一个受控的基准来将任务完成与偏好满足区分开来。我们提出了 LIBERO-PeRM，一个用于具身智能体偏好学习的基准。LIBERO-PeRM 研究五个问题：1）策略在零样本设置下如何遵循偏好；2）它们如何从演示中学习单一偏好；3）随着演示增加，它们获取偏好的效率如何；4）学习到的偏好如何跨布局和任务泛化；5）策略如何组合偏好并在冲突下表现。我们提出了模拟中可观测偏好的受控表述与分类体系，涵盖动作、技能和用户画像选择。该表述仅限于可用语言表达的偏好，这些偏好可以在不改变任务目标的情况下在 LIBERO 中实例化、自动评估并跨任务复用。基于 LIBERO，我们的程序化流水线生成带有偏好和不带偏好的配对演示。我们创建了五个任务套件（312 个任务），包含高质量演示、丰富的元数据和偏好满足度量。实验表明，当前的 VLA 策略在零样本个性化方面表现不佳，而 SFT 使偏好变得可学习。混合训练在无偏好保持方面优于顺序适应，并且在上下文提示下相比仅偏好训练提升了性能，但可能削弱动作偏好的学习；偏好泛化、分解和冲突处理仍然困难。代码、数据集和演示可在项目网站找到：https://libero-perm.github.io/。

papers.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
papers.translated_title: Gen4P：视频生成器是四维感知器
papers.author: Yitong Xia
papers.summary: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出Gen4P，一个从单目视频中恢复4D几何与运动的统一框架。我们表明，预训练的视频生成器可以被重新用作前馈4D感知器，而无需迭代去噪。基于按需查询，Gen4P在单次编码器传递中处理干净的视频潜在表示，并通过轻量级交叉注意力解码器预测所请求的4D属性。按需查询公式实现了灵活的空间采样，而我们提出的连续时间查询进一步提供了时间灵活性。为增强几何知识，我们提出一种直接的即插即用方案，将预训练的视频深度LoRA作为冻结的几何先验引入，在不增加额外可训练参数的情况下提升整体性能。Gen4P在3D点跟踪、视频深度和相机位姿估计任务上达到最先进或具有竞争力的性能。在野外视频上的定性结果展示了其在跟踪复杂运动的同时保持精细结构的能力。这些结果共同证明了视频生成预训练在统一4D感知方面的潜力。更多视觉结果见https://gen4p.github.io。

papers.title: Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation
papers.translated_title: 哪些Token应当合并？面向高效图像生成的扩散动力学
papers.author: SeungJu Cha
papers.summary: Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.
papers.translated_summary: Token merging已成为一种有效的免训练策略，通过减少冗余token计算来加速扩散模型，同时最小化生成质量下降。一个关键挑战是确定哪些token可以安全合并，哪些应保留用于后续计算。现有方法通过保留与提示对齐的前景区域来应对这一问题，从而保护语义相关的结构。然而，这种文本相关性准则忽略了背景对象以及提示中未明确提及的局部细节，导致结构连贯性下降。在本工作中，我们提出Dynamics-aware Token Merging（DaTMe），一个免训练框架，将token merging建立在底层扩散动力学之上。我们的关键洞见是，token重要性应反映该token在去噪过程中是否仍未确定，以及它是否携带结构信息。为此，DaTMe从Tweedie去噪估计中构建动力学感知重要性图。该图结合了时间信号——衡量预测干净图像在相邻步骤间的变化——与结构信号——捕获局部高频内容，如边界和精细细节。利用该图，DaTMe在给定压缩比下自适应地将token分配为合并角色：重要token作为锚点保留，而时间上已稳定且结构上同质的token被选为安全合并候选。在PixArt-a和FLUX上的实验表明，DaTMe在整个图像上保持视觉保真度，突显了扩散动力学作为高效生成中有效的token级合并决策。我们的代码可在https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe获取。

papers.title: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers
papers.translated_title: SoftCache：面向扩散Transformer的自适应步长缓存
papers.author: Shimon Malnick
papers.summary: Diffusion and flow models generate a sample over iterative steps, each a full pass through a large network, and that pass dominates generation cost. Training-free caching accelerates them by reusing activations from recent evaluations instead of recomputing them. Dynamic caching methods decide when to refresh by accumulating a cheap probe of the network input into a staleness signal and spending a fresh evaluation once it crosses a threshold. They perform hard caching: the signal is a binary switch between refresh and reuse, and every step, fresh or cached, advances by the prescribed step size. We observe that the signal carries much more than this switch. How far it sits below the threshold, its headroom, predicts the error induced by reuse. We propose SoftCache, which performs soft caching: instead of a binary switch, the headroom sets how far each cached step goes. Where the headroom is large, the sampler jumps past several scheduled nodes, and as a refresh nears, its steps shrink back toward the original step. These adaptive jumps may land between the scheduled nodes, taking the sampler off its fixed grid. SoftCache requires no training and adds no per-backbone settings: on FLUX for images and on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1 for video, at speedups from $3.5\times$ to $6.9\times$, it is ahead of every baseline on all four fidelity metrics.
papers.translated_summary: 扩散模型和流模型通过迭代步骤生成样本，每一步都要完整地通过一个大型网络，而这一过程主导了生成成本。免训练缓存通过复用近期评估中的激活值而非重新计算来加速这些模型。动态缓存方法通过将网络输入的廉价探针累积为陈旧度信号，并在其越过阈值时进行一次新的评估，从而决定何时刷新。它们执行硬缓存：该信号是刷新与复用之间的二元开关，且每一步无论新算还是缓存，都按规定的步长推进。我们观察到，该信号所携带的信息远不止这个开关。它低于阈值的程度，即其余量，可以预测复用所引入的误差。我们提出SoftCache，它执行软缓存：余量不再作为二元开关，而是决定每个缓存步骤推进多远。在余量较大处，采样器跳过若干个预定节点；而当刷新临近时，其步长会收缩回原始步长。这些自适应跳跃可能落在预定节点之间，使采样器偏离其固定网格。SoftCache无需训练，也不增加任何逐骨干网络的设置：在图像任务上使用FLUX，在视频任务上使用HunyuanVideo和Wan2.1，在3.5倍到6.9倍的加速下，它在全部四项保真度指标上均领先于所有基线方法。

papers.title: Value as Memory: Online Value-Guided Post-training for General Robot Policies
papers.translated_title: 价值即记忆：面向通用机器人策略的在线价值引导后训练
papers.author: Wenye Yu
papers.summary: Real-world post-training of generalist robot policies faces two challenges: partial observability makes action selection ambiguous, while offline post-training methods delay feedback from deployment experience. We present Value as Memory (VaM), a framework that addresses these challenges through value caching and online real-world reinforcement learning (RL). Value caching conditions actions on recent value predictions as task-progress memory, while online updates enable timely policy improvement by combining offline demonstrations, off-policy interventions, and on-policy rollouts for sample-efficient adaptation. As a result, VaM transitions from offline RL warmup to online autonomous learning with sparse rewards. Across long-horizon tasks involving deformable objects and contact-rich manipulation, VaM yields a mean absolute success-rate gain of $29.4\%$ with value caching, while achieving a $32.8\%$ gain with online autonomous learning over matched offline training. The evaluated online schedule performs $8\times$ as many policy iterations under the same gradient-step budget, with more than $2\times$ lower recorded time per gradient step with concurrent data collection and training.
papers.translated_summary: 通用机器人策略的真实世界后训练面临两个挑战：部分可观测性使动作选择存在歧义，而离线后训练方法延迟了来自部署经验的反馈。我们提出价值即记忆（Value as Memory，VaM），一个通过价值缓存和在线真实世界强化学习（RL）应对这些挑战的框架。价值缓存以近期价值预测作为任务进度记忆来约束动作，而在线更新通过结合离线演示、离策略干预和同策略 rollout 实现及时的策改进，以实现样本高效的适应。因此，VaM 从离线 RL 预热过渡到具有稀疏奖励的在线自主学习。在涉及可变形物体和接触丰富操作的长时程任务中，VaM 通过价值缓存获得平均绝对成功率提升 $29.4\%$，而在匹配的离线训练基础上通过在线自主学习获得 $32.8\%$ 的提升。所评估的在线调度在相同梯度步预算下执行了 $8\times$ 的策略迭代次数，并且在并发数据收集与训练下，每梯度步记录时间降低超过 $2\times$。

papers.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
papers.translated_title: 利用大型语言模型发现最先进的量子电路
papers.author: Andi Gu
papers.summary: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.
papers.translated_summary: 目前，大量工作正致力于实现大规模量子信息处理器，但要实现有用的量子优势，还需要开发高效的量子算法。尽管对许多实际问题而言，主要的资源成本与一小组计算原语相关，但在量子环境中优化这些原语面临着独特的挑战，其中包括普通经典计算中不存在的可逆性约束。在此，我们引入一个进化框架，其中大语言模型（LLMs）提出电路设计，并由独立的评估器进行验证和评分。我们将该框架应用于涵盖数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论的任务。在八个任务中的七个里，所发现的电路相较于当前最先进水平显著减少了Toffoli门和量子比特的数量。在第八个任务中，搜索发现了一种用于素数域模逆的新可逆架构。通过以不同方式处理可逆性，该架构使divsteps——一种此前用于可逆整数算术不切实际的经典算法——变得可行，并大幅改善了模逆的Toffoli门与量子比特之间的权衡。这些结果为评估器引导的LLM协同设计量子计算的新算法结构打开了大门。

papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
papers.translated_title: T2-z：面向机器人世界模型的环境潜在变量测试时优化
papers.author: Chenyuan Zhou
papers.summary: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.
papers.translated_summary: 预测世界对某一动作的响应，仅凭可观测信息是不够的：机器人必须考虑既不能直接观测也无法明确指定的环境因素，从摩擦和质量等物理属性到人类定义的环境规则。我们提出T2-Z用于环境隐变量的测试时优化，它为机器人世界模型增加一个可学习的环境隐变量，以条件化世界预测。这一紧凑隐变量在无需监督环境因素存在何种因素或取何值的情况下，捕捉潜在的环境变化。在训练期间，T2-Z在两个阶段之间交替：世界模型优化阶段固定隐变量并学习跨环境的一般动作条件动力学；环境隐变量优化阶段冻结世界模型并优化条件隐变量，使隐变量结构纯粹通过世界预测涌现。在测试时，世界模型保持冻结，新初始化的环境隐变量从一个或多个测试时交互中优化，使模型适应先前未见的环境配置。在7个模拟设置和4个真实世界机器人任务中，T2-Z将物体预测误差指标从15.20降至7.00，并将动作成功率从33.73%提升至72.96%。其涌现的隐变量在多样视觉场景中捕捉到个体因素与复合因素的结构化表示。消融实验进一步表明，T2-Z能够仅从单条测试时交互轨迹中高效推断环境隐变量。

papers.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
papers.translated_title: 感知、预测与规划：一种用于第一人称视角灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型
papers.author: Zirui Wu
papers.summary: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出P$^{3}$-WAM，一个用于自我中心灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型，通过三种互补模式学习三维感知、动作条件预测和目标导向规划：Perceive，从视频中重建关节手部运动和相机轨迹；Predict，在给定动作下生成视觉未来；Plan，以初始图像、语言指令和可选视觉目标为条件，联合生成动作轨迹及其预期视觉后果。我们的模型通过混合Transformer架构将紧凑的结构化三维动作表示集成到预训练视频扩散Transformer中，该架构具有共享基础权重、模态特定适配和双向视觉-动作注意力。随机化模态可见性使视频和三维动作在三种模式中均可作为条件上下文或预测目标。实验表明，统一训练在全部三项能力上均优于单模式训练，包括在视觉语言模型评估下规划质量的提升。通过统一训练，我们的模型在四个数据集上的三维手部重建和动作条件视频预测方面优于专门基线，同时生成的目标导向操作视频在指令遵循和动作进展方面优于视频生成基线。项目页面：https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

papers.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.translated_title: CoDA：数据引擎与行动策略的协同演化
papers.author: Tianjiao Yu
papers.summary: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.
papers.translated_summary: 生成式仿真可以自动化机器人环境构建，但物理上有效的环境未必对训练有用。挑战在于识别能够针对策略失败的环境，以及帮助策略克服这些失败的监督。我们提出CoDA，一个框架，其中仿真数据引擎与动作策略通过一个共享的异构记忆协同演化，该记忆涵盖环境构建、策略失败和学习进展。该记忆将来自视觉语言批评器的经过验证的诊断编译为生成程序，以重现困难，并编译为帮助策略克服困难的训练程序。我们进一步提出Text2potential，将这些诊断转换为用于动作块价值学习的分阶段势函数，在标准塑形假设下为策略更新提供密集监督，同时保持任务的最优策略。测得的 learning progress 指导进一步的生成和程序改进。在四个操作任务族上，CoDA将分布外成功率从监督微调后的5.3%提升至27.6%，在相同生成预算下超过最强的闭环基线9.5个百分点。在LIBERO-Pro上，15轮生成和训练将位置扰动下的成功率从25%提升至84%，将指令扰动下的成功率从1%提升至76%。

papers.title: Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content
papers.translated_title: 将生成式验证建立在3D内容之上
papers.author: Shuanglin Li
papers.summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.
papers.translated_summary: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与3D生成的最新进展拓展了3D理解与合成能力。然而，超越视觉保真度，基于3D证据的任务特定正确性仍是一大挑战。我们认为，构建可靠的3D系统不仅需要更强的生成与推理能力，还需要验证反馈来识别未满足的要求并解释其违规之处，从而使系统能够反思并改进其输出。此类反馈必须整合多视角观测，并区分真正的不一致与依赖投影的表观差异。我们做出三项贡献。第一，我们提出3DVerifierBench，一个涵盖10项任务的基准，用于评估决策、拒绝解释以及对规格和候选对象受控变化的响应。一项人类研究显示，人类与测试中最强模型GPT-6 Astra之间存在21.6个百分点的差距，而解释感知分析揭示了拒绝可靠性方面的弱点。第二，我们跨细粒度事实类别分析验证，暴露了数值和目标绑定中的错误。我们开发了一个可扩展的流水线，结合多视角事实提取、受控3D编辑和原生标注，生成14,126个训练样本，包含矛盾解释和关联的反事实。第三，我们考察验证如何通过候选选择和递归改进来支持3D生成。在人工标注的十六候选池中，预言机选择将完整事实成功率从26.7%提升至90.0%。在另一项八输入研究中，人工引导的递归改进对每个输入均满足全部七项要求，而并行Oracle@8下仅满足三项。总之，我们的基准、分析和数据流水线为模型通过可靠验证反馈反思3D内容奠定了基础。

papers.title: Neuroelectrophysiological correlates of extended cessation of consciousness in advanced meditators: A multimodal EEG and MEG study
papers.translated_title: 高级冥想者意识长期停止的神经电生理相关因素：一项多模态脑电图和脑磁图研究
papers.author: Shinozuka, K.
papers.summary: In some contemplative traditions, 'extended cessation' (EC) refers to a state of advanced meditation in which the meditator self-reports intentionally suppressing their own consciousness and re-emerging with a profound sense of clarity and equanimity. Here, we present the first electrophysiological study of EC, in which five meditators underwent concurrent electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) recording. EC significantly increased high-frequency global coherence in all five of the participants, yet it did not consistently affect Lempel-Ziv complexity or power across participants. Our results provide preliminary evidence that the neural signatures of EC may be distinct from other states that are characterized by a loss of consciousness, including deep sleep and anesthesia. EC may not be simply 'switching off' consciousness but rather reorganizing the neural dynamics that underlie consciousness.
papers.translated_summary: 在一些冥想传统中，“延长的止息”（extended cessation，EC）指的是一种高级冥想状态，冥想者自我报告有意抑制自身意识，并在重新出现时带有深刻的清晰感与平等心。在此，我们呈现首个关于EC的电生理研究，其中五名冥想者同时接受了脑电图（EEG）和脑磁图（MEG）记录。EC显著提高了全部五名参与者的高频全局相干性，但并未在参与者之间一致地影响Lempel-Ziv复杂度或功率。我们的结果为以下观点提供了初步证据：EC的神经特征可能不同于以意识丧失为特征的其他状态，包括深度睡眠和麻醉。EC可能并非简单地“关闭”意识，而是重组了支撑意识的神经动力学。

papers.title: Ethmoid bone marrow region modulates lymphoid activation and differentiation with distinct myeloid profile in neuroinflammation
papers.translated_title: 筛骨骨髓区域在神经炎症中调节淋巴细胞的激活与分化，并具有独特的髓系特征
papers.author: Laaker, C. J.
papers.summary: The skull bone marrow axis has recently emerged as an important source of immune cells during neuroinflammation, including in the experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) , the mouse model of multiple sclerosis. The cribriform plate bone marrow (cpBM), is a portion of the ethmoid bone of the skull of mice, and is positioned next to nasal regions. At the cribriform plate olfactory nerves pass through the skull and recent evidence supports that it represents an important immune niche with links to CSF outflow and connections to cpBM. Previous data supports cellular composition of the ethmoid bone marrow in mice is altered in neuroinflammation suggesting it senses inflammatory cues, but the exact nature of these changes is still unclear. Here using scRNAseq and flow cytometry of the ethmoid bone marrow region we test how the region responds to EAE. In addition we also compare the cpBM region with systemic bone marrow in the femur to understand region specific differences. We report that neuroinflammation creates a regulatory response at these sites and implicates the cpBM in controlling these effects. A better understanding of the cribriform niche may offer new treatments for neuroinflammatory disease
papers.translated_summary: 颅骨骨髓轴近年来已成为神经炎症过程中免疫细胞的重要来源，包括在多发性硬化症的小鼠模型——实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）中。筛板骨髓（cpBM）是小鼠颅骨筛骨的一部分，位于鼻腔区域旁边。在筛板处，嗅神经穿过颅骨，近期证据支持该区域是一个重要的免疫微环境，与脑脊液外流相关并与cpBM存在联系。先前数据支持小鼠筛骨骨髓的细胞组成在神经炎症中发生改变，提示其感知炎症信号，但这些变化的确切性质仍不清楚。本研究利用筛骨骨髓区域的单细胞RNA测序（scRNAseq）和流式细胞术，检测该区域如何响应EAE。此外，我们还比较了cpBM区域与股骨系统性骨髓，以了解区域特异性差异。我们报告神经炎症在这些位点产生调节性反应，并提示cpBM参与控制这些效应。更好地理解筛板微环境可能为神经炎症性疾病提供新的治疗方法。

papers.title: Structure-informed evolutionary analysis of the meiotic recombination machinery
papers.translated_title: 结构信息驱动的减数分裂重组机制进化分析
papers.author: Arter, M.
papers.summary: Despite being essential for fertility, many proteins involved in meiotic homologous recombination have diverged rapidly. The evolutionary forces driving this divergence remain mostly unknown, in part because of challenges in accounting for the interplay of sequence changes with constraints imposed by proteins' structures and physiological roles. Here, we explore strategies to more sensitively detect signatures of positive or relaxed selection by integrating evolutionary analyses with structural and functional information, using meiotic recombination proteins in four taxa--primates, rodents, birds and budding yeasts. By mapping selection rate estimates onto predicted protein structures, we characterized protein regions likely to have experienced positive selection. We further identified subtle sequence variation within protein domains that are well conserved generally because of structural constraints. To detect sequence variation masked by these constraints, we analyzed selection at structurally matched residues, comparing homologs across different lineages as well as between meiosis-specific and generalist paralogs. These approaches identified lineage- and paralog-restricted enrichment of non-synonymous substitutions that may indicate loss of functional constraints and/or adaptive innovation. Finally, we used cross-species complementation experiments in Saccharomyces cerevisiae to show that sequence variation in the pro-crossover factor MSH4 modulates recombination proficiency. We suggest that evolutionary plasticity per se is a key conserved characteristic of the meiotic recombination machinery. More generally, our approach provides a mechanistic framework to analyze protein evolution.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管对生育至关重要，许多参与减数分裂同源重组的蛋白质却迅速分化。驱动这种分化的进化力量在很大程度上仍不清楚，部分原因在于难以将序列变化与蛋白质结构和生理角色所施加的约束之间的相互作用纳入考量。在此，我们探索了将进化分析与结构和功能信息相结合，以更灵敏地检测正选择或松弛选择特征的策略，研究对象为四个类群——灵长类、啮齿类、鸟类和芽殖酵母——中的减数分裂重组蛋白。通过将选择速率估计值映射到预测的蛋白质结构上，我们刻画了可能经历正选择的蛋白质区域。我们进一步识别了由于结构约束而总体高度保守的蛋白质结构域内的细微序列变异。为了检测被这些约束所掩盖的序列变异，我们分析了结构匹配残基上的选择，比较了不同谱系之间的同源物，以及减数分裂特异性与通用型旁系同源物之间的差异。这些方法识别出谱系特异性和旁系同源物特异性的非同义替换富集，这可能指示功能约束的丧失和/或适应性创新。最后，我们利用酿酒酵母中的跨物种互补实验表明，促交换因子MSH4的序列变异调节重组效率。我们认为，进化可塑性本身就是减数分裂重组机制的一个关键保守特征。更广泛地说，我们的方法提供了一个分析蛋白质进化的机制性框架。

papers.title: Spatial Single-Cell Mapping of Transcriptional Differences Across Genetic Backgrounds in Mouse Brains
papers.translated_title: 小鼠大脑中不同遗传背景转录差异的空间单细胞图谱
papers.author: Hemminger, Z.
papers.summary: Genetic variation can alter organ structure and, in turn, function. Comparative statistical analysis of organs across genetic backgrounds requires spatial, single-cell, atlas-scale data in replicates, which current technologies do not provide at scale. We introduce Atlas-scale Transcriptome Localization using Aggregate Signatures (ATLAS), a scalable tissue mapping method. ATLAS learns transcriptional signatures from scRNAseq data, encodes them in situ with tens of thousands of oligonucleotide probes, and decodes them to infer cell types and imputed transcriptomes. We validated ATLAS in the mouse brain by comparing its cell type inferences with direct MERFISH measurements of marker genes and quantitative comparisons to four other technologies. Using ATLAS, we mapped the central brains of five male and five female C57BL/6J (B6) mice and five male BTBR T+ tf/J (BTBR) mice, an idiopathic model of autism, collectively profiling 40 million cells across over 400 coronal sections. Our analysis revealed over 40 significant differences in cell type distributions and identified 16 regional composition changes across male-female and B6-BTBR comparisons. ATLAS thus enables systematic comparative studies, facilitating organ-level structure-function analysis of disease models.
papers.translated_summary: 遗传变异可以改变器官结构，进而改变其功能。跨遗传背景的器官比较统计分析需要重复样本中的空间、单细胞、图谱规模数据，而当前技术无法大规模提供这些数据。我们提出了基于聚合特征的图谱规模转录组定位（ATLAS），一种可扩展的组织映射方法。ATLAS从scRNAseq数据中学习转录特征，用数万个寡核苷酸探针在原位编码这些特征，并解码以推断细胞类型和插补转录组。我们通过将ATLAS的细胞类型推断与标记基因的直接MERFISH测量进行比较，并与其他四种技术进行定量比较，在小鼠大脑中验证了ATLAS。利用ATLAS，我们绘制了五只雄性和五只雌性C57BL/6J（B6）小鼠以及五只雄性BTBR T+ tf/J（BTBR）小鼠（一种特发性自闭症模型）的中心大脑，共分析了超过400个冠状切片中的4000万个细胞。我们的分析揭示了细胞类型分布中超过40个显著差异，并在雄-雌和B6-BTBR比较中识别出16个区域组成变化。因此，ATLAS能够实现系统性比较研究，促进疾病模型的器官级结构-功能分析。

papers.title: Maize and wild relatives show distinct patterns of genome downsizing following polyploidy
papers.translated_title: 玉米及其野生近缘种在多倍化后表现出不同的基因组缩减模式
papers.author: Snodgrass, S. J.
papers.summary: Repeated cycles of polyploidy and gene loss during diploidization have shaped plant genomes over evolutionary time. This loss of gene sequence post-polyploidy is known as fractionation. Gene duplicates (i.e., homoeologs) from each ancestral diploid genome (i.e., subgenome) may fractionate differently, resulting in one subgenome being preferentially retained. Previous work suggests fractionation occurs shortly after a polyploidy event. Yet, few studies have explicitly compared genome-wide fractionation patterns across genera sharing the same whole genome duplication (WGD) to clarify how patterns of fractionation distinguish species over time. The Tripsacinae subtribe of grasses, which includes the genera Tripsacum and Zea, share an ancient allotetraploidy event ~5-12 MYA. Using publicly available genome assemblies for the Tripsacinae subtribe including wild lineages and the domesticate maize, we investigate patterns of fractionation. Across genomes, the majority of fractionation is shared across species and one subgenome is preferentially retained. However, ~35% of exons were fractionated differently across species, with significantly more differences between genomes of Tripsacum and Zea. We found no support of incomplete lineage sorting explaining fractionation differences across genera. Rather, the most striking trend is Tripsacum retaining a substantially greater proportion of homoeolog pairs than Zea where gene loss has been more prevalent.
papers.translated_summary: 多倍化与二倍化过程中基因丢失的反复循环在进化时间尺度上塑造了植物基因组。多倍化后基因序列的这种丢失被称为分馏。来自每个祖先二倍体基因组（即亚基因组）的基因重复（即同源基因）可能以不同方式分馏，导致一个亚基因组被优先保留。先前的研究表明分馏发生在多倍化事件后不久。然而，很少有研究明确比较共享同一全基因组复制（WGD）的属之间的全基因组分馏模式，以阐明分馏模式如何随时间区分物种。禾本科的Tripsacinae亚族包括Tripsacum属和Zea属，共享约5-12百万年前的一次古老异源四倍化事件。利用Tripsacinae亚族包括野生谱系和栽培玉米的公开基因组组装，我们研究了分馏模式。在各基因组中，大部分分馏在物种间共享，且一个亚基因组被优先保留。然而，约35%的外显子在物种间存在不同的分馏，Tripsacum和Zea基因组之间的差异显著更多。我们未发现不完全谱系分选解释属间分馏差异的证据。相反，最显著的趋势是Tripsacum保留的同源基因对比例远高于基因丢失更为普遍的Zea。

papers.title: BTK dynamics and function are differentially influenced by distinct covalent inhibitor warhead chemistries.
papers.translated_title: BTK动力学和功能受不同共价抑制剂弹头化学性质的差异化影响。
papers.author: Joseph, R. E.
papers.summary: Covalent inhibitors are rapidly becoming the standard of care for treatment of a range of disease states. Covalent inhibitors bind irreversibly to their target using a reactive electrophile (or warhead). Acrylamide and 2-butynamide are the most commonly used cysteine targeting electrophiles. These warheads are chosen for their efficient and selective modification of the protein and are presumed to be otherwise functionally inert. Using a panel of BTK covalent inhibitors (Tirabrutinib, Acalabrutinib, Ibrutinib and Zanubrutinib), we show that the 2-butynamide warhead on Tirabrutinib and Acalabrutinib, unlike the acrylamide warhead on Ibrutinib and Zanubrutinib, induces conformational heterogeneity in key regions required for BTK signaling. Tirabrutinib or Acalabrutinib bound BTK adopt multiple conformational states that are in dynamic exchange, show increased binding to the substrate PLC{gamma} and are less effective at inhibiting PLC{gamma} signaling when compared to Ibrutinib. Swapping only the warheads between Tirabrutinib and Ibrutinib leads to a corresponding switch in BTK dynamics and inhibitor efficacy. The unanticipated warhead-specific allosteric effects raise interesting possibilities regarding inhibitor-specific mechanisms of resistance.
papers.translated_summary: 共价抑制剂正迅速成为治疗多种疾病状态的标准疗法。共价抑制剂利用反应性亲电体（或弹头）与靶标不可逆结合。丙烯酰胺和2-丁炔酰胺是最常用的靶向半胱氨酸的亲电体。选择这些弹头是因为它们能高效、选择性地修饰蛋白质，并且假定在其他方面功能上是惰性的。利用一组BTK共价抑制剂（Tirabrutinib、Acalabrutinib、Ibrutinib和Zanubrutinib），我们发现Tirabrutinib和Acalabrutinib上的2-丁炔酰胺弹头与Ibrutinib和Zanubrutinib上的丙烯酰胺弹头不同，会在BTK信号传导所需的关键区域诱导构象异质性。与Ibrutinib相比，结合BTK的Tirabrutinib或Acalabrutinib采用多种处于动态交换的构象状态，显示出与底物PLC{gamma}的结合增加，并且在抑制PLC{gamma}信号传导方面效果较差。仅交换Tirabrutinib和Ibrutinib之间的弹头，就会导致BTK动力学和抑制剂疗效的相应改变。这种意想不到的弹头特异性变构效应，为抑制剂特异性耐药机制提出了有趣的的可能性。

papers.title: Mapping the spatial architecture of glioblastoma from core to edge delineates niche-specific tumor cell states and intercellular interactions
papers.translated_title: 从核心到边缘绘制胶质母细胞瘤的空间结构，界定了生态位特异性的肿瘤细胞状态和细胞间相互作用
papers.author: Khan, S. M.
papers.summary: Treatment resistance in glioblastoma (GBM) is largely driven by the extensive multi-level heterogeneity that typifies this disease. Despite significant progress toward elucidating GBM's genomic and transcriptional heterogeneity, a critical knowledge gap remains in defining this heterogeneity at the spatial level. To address this, we employed spatial transcriptomics to map the architecture of the GBM ecosystem. This revealed tumor cell states that are jointly defined by gene expression and spatial localization, and multicellular niches whose composition varies along the tumor core-edge axis. Ligand-receptor interaction analysis uncovered a complex network of intercellular communication, including niche- and region-specific interactions. Finally, we found that CD8+GZMK+ T cells colocalize with LYVE1+ CD163+ myeloid cells in vascular regions, suggesting a potential mechanism for immune evasion. These findings provide novel insights into the GBM tumor microenvironment, highlighting previously unrecognized patterns of spatial organization and intercellular interactions, and novel therapeutic avenues to disrupt tumor-promoting interactions and overcome immune resistance.
papers.translated_summary: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）的治疗耐药性在很大程度上由该疾病典型的多层次异质性所驱动。尽管在阐明GBM的基因组和转录异质性方面已取得显著进展，但在空间层面界定这种异质性方面仍存在关键的知识空白。为解决这一问题，我们采用空间转录组学来绘制GBM生态系统的结构图谱。这揭示了由基因表达和空间定位共同定义的肿瘤细胞状态，以及组成沿肿瘤核心-边缘轴变化的多细胞生态位。配体-受体相互作用分析揭示了复杂的细胞间通讯网络，包括生态位特异性和区域特异性的相互作用。最后，我们发现CD8+GZMK+ T细胞与LYVE1+ CD163+髓系细胞在血管区域共定位，提示了一种潜在的免疫逃逸机制。这些发现为GBM肿瘤微环境提供了新的见解，突出了此前未被认识的空间组织和细胞间相互作用模式，以及破坏促肿瘤相互作用和克服免疫抵抗的新治疗途径。

papers.title: Directed evolution of L-DOPA sensing and production enables efficient incorporation of an expanded genetic code into proteins
papers.translated_title: L-DOPA传感与生产的定向进化使扩展遗传密码高效整合入蛋白质
papers.author: Gilmour, A. R.
papers.summary: L-3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine (L-DOPA), is a versatile catechol-containing amino acid derived from L-tyrosine that is both a key metabolite for the production of many valuable natural products and a naturally occurring post-translational modification in proteins. While advances in microbial natural product biosynthesis and site-specific incorporation of L-DOPA have both paved the way for relevant applications of L-DOPA, progress has been stifled by a lack of robust in vivo detection tools and high-efficiency biosynthetic enzymes. Here, we report and engineer a LysR-family transcription factor, PP_2251, that can serve as a transcriptional regulator for L-DOPA with a dynamic range of >100-fold when coupled with a fluorescent reporter. Leveraging this improved regulator in conjunction with compartmentalized partnered replication (CPR), we engineered a promiscuous E. coli flavin-dependent monooxygenase (HpaB) for enhanced L-DOPA biosynthesis. This represents the first use of high-throughput emulsion PCR to improve a metabolic enzyme and yielded HpaB variants that showed >40-fold activity within our genetic circuit and a 6-fold increase in L-DOPA titer compared to wild-type HpaB. We further demonstrated that the highest performing HpaB variant was capable of supporting efficient translational incorporation of L-DOPA into protein, achieving 97% incorporation efficiency and yields approaching 250 mg.L-1. Collectively, these advancements enable the in vivo detection, biosynthesis, and site-specific incorporation of L-DOPA for synthetic and chemical biology applications.
papers.translated_summary: L-3,4-二羟基苯丙氨酸（L-DOPA）是一种含有儿茶酚的多功能氨基酸，衍生自L-酪氨酸，既是生产许多有价值天然产物的关键代谢物，也是蛋白质中天然存在的翻译后修饰。尽管微生物天然产物生物合成和L-DOPA位点特异性掺入的进展都为L-DOPA的相关应用铺平了道路，但由于缺乏稳健的体内检测工具和高效生物合成酶，进展受到阻碍。在此，我们报道并改造了一个LysR家族转录因子PP_2251，当与荧光报告基因偶联时，它可作为L-DOPA的转录调节因子，动态范围超过100倍。利用这一改进的调节因子结合区室化配对复制（CPR），我们改造了一种宽底物特异性的大肠杆菌黄素依赖型单加氧酶（HpaB），以增强L-DOPA的生物合成。这代表了首次使用高通量乳液PCR来改进代谢酶，并产生了HpaB变体，在我们的遗传回路中显示出超过40倍的活性，与野生型HpaB相比，L-DOPA滴度增加了6倍。我们进一步证明，性能最高的HpaB变体能够支持L-DOPA高效翻译掺入蛋白质，实现了97%的掺入效率和接近250 mg.L-1的产量。总的来说，这些进展使得L-DOPA的体内检测、生物合成和位点特异性掺入成为可能，用于合成和化学生物学应用。

papers.title: Cognitive tests of pattern separation as sleep-sensitive measures in middle-aged and older adults: An exploratory study
papers.translated_title: 中老年人模式分离的认知测试作为睡眠敏感指标：一项探索性研究
papers.author: Roenningen, A. E.
papers.summary: Sleep disturbances are considered both a dementia risk factor and symptom. The present research aimed to identify cognitive tests sensitive to objective sleep quantity or quality, focusing on tests designed to evaluate the earliest cognitive changes in dementia. We recruited adults who were 50 years or older and remotely monitored their sleep patterns for 7 consecutive days using wrist actigraphy and sleep diaries. On day 7, participants completed different cognitive tests; the Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT), the Prodromal Alzheimers and Mild Cognitive Impairment battery from the Cambridge Neuropsychological Test Automated Battery (CANTAB), the Mnemonic Similarity Task (MST), taxing pattern separation, and the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA). The final sample included 34 participants (mean age: 65.56, SD: 9.57). There were significant correlations between objective sleep quantity and PVT and MST performance. MoCA scores were correlated with performance on CANTAB and MST. Objective sleep quantity predicted MST performance when controlling for age, sex, and education. Tests of pattern separation are sensitive to objective sleep quantity and early cognitive changes associated with dementia. The sensitivity of pattern separation tests to sleep should be evaluated in a larger study, aiming to identify suitable clinical trial outcome measures for sleep-promoting treatments in older adults.
papers.translated_summary: 睡眠障碍既被视为痴呆的风险因素，也被视为其症状。本研究旨在识别对客观睡眠数量或质量敏感的认知测试，重点关注设计用于评估痴呆最早认知变化的测试。我们招募了50岁及以上的成年人，并使用腕部活动记录仪和睡眠日记对其连续7天的睡眠模式进行远程监测。第7天，参与者完成了不同的认知测试：精神运动警觉任务（PVT）、剑桥神经心理测试自动化成套测验（CANTAB）中的前驱阿尔茨海默病与轻度认知障碍 battery、 taxing模式分离的记忆相似性任务（MST），以及蒙特利尔认知评估（MoCA）。最终样本包括34名参与者（平均年龄：65.56，标准差：9.57）。客观睡眠数量与PVT和MST表现之间存在显著相关性。MoCA得分与CANTAB和MST的表现相关。在控制年龄、性别和教育程度后，客观睡眠数量预测了MST表现。模式分离测试对客观睡眠数量及与痴呆相关的早期认知变化具有敏感性。应在更大规模的研究中评估模式分离测试对睡眠的敏感性，旨在为老年人促睡眠治疗的临床试验确定合适的结局指标。

papers.title: Tetradic Dynamics of Dyadic Sensorimotor Coordination: A Multiscale EEG Hyperscanning Study
papers.translated_title: 双人感觉运动协调的四元动力学：一项多尺度脑电超扫描研究
papers.author: Olarewaju, E.
papers.summary: How do leader and follower roles shape the brain mechanisms that support coordinated action between people? This question has therapeutic relevance for conditions such as schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorder, where the capacity for reciprocal social coordination is a defining vulnerability. Here, we propose a tetradic framework and examine sensorimotor coordination in 16 healthy adult pairs (15 included in EEG analyses) using dual-brain EEG hyperscanning and a 2x2 within-subject design crossing Role (Leader/Follower) and Condition (Mirroring/Matching). Mirroring required resonance with a partner's movement; Matching required its controlled transformation. This contrast was designed to dissociate automatic from controlled coordination. Behaviourally, Mirroring produced a robust Follower reaction-time advantage: pooling an independent behavioural-only cohort (combined N=64) revealed a smaller Leader advantage, consistent with role-dependent attention-inhibition gating. At the neural level, tonic power and significant phasic condition clusters were greater during Matching than Mirroring, while role-dependent phasic clusters suggested an anticipatory sequence around Leader responses and post-response gating and rebound around Follower responses. Information-theoretic decomposition identified Leader-weighted predictive information in frontal and posterior perceptual regions, Follower-specific adaptive information across frontoparietal and sensorimotor cortices, sparse Synergy in lateral occipital, fusiform, and paracentral cortices, and Redundancy linking pars opercularis and lateral occipital cortex. These findings characterize tetradic coordination within dyads as a multiscale, role-asymmetric architecture in which top-down predictive control and bottom-up adaptive regulation are functionally dissociable. The tetradic framework provides an organizing scaffold for this dissociation, and the role-specific signatures it reveals may offer candidate biomarkers for clinical populations in whom interpersonal coordination is disrupted.
papers.translated_summary: 领导者和追随者角色如何塑造支撑人际协调行动的大脑机制？这一问题对精神分裂症和自闭症谱系障碍等疾病具有治疗相关性，在这些疾病中，互惠性社会协调能力是标志性的脆弱环节。在此，我们提出一个四元框架，并使用双脑EEG超扫描和2x2被试内设计（交叉角色（领导者/追随者）与条件（镜像/匹配））考察16对健康成年人（其中15对纳入EEG分析）的感觉运动协调。镜像要求与伙伴的运动产生共振；匹配要求对其运动进行受控转换。这一对比旨在分离自动协调与受控协调。在行为层面，镜像产生了稳健的追随者反应时优势：合并一个独立的行为-only队列（合并N=64）后，显示出较小的领导者优势，这与角色依赖的注意-抑制门控一致。在神经层面，匹配期间的强直功率和显著相位条件簇大于镜像期间，而角色依赖的相位簇提示领导者反应前后的预期序列以及追随者反应前后的门控与回弹。信息论分解识别出额叶和后部知觉区域中领导者加权的预测信息、跨额顶和感觉运动皮层的追随者特异性适应信息、外侧枕叶、梭状回和旁中央皮层中稀疏的协同信息，以及连接岛盖部和外侧枕叶皮层的冗余信息。这些发现将二人组内的四元协调表征为一种多尺度、角色不对称的架构，其中自上而下的预测控制和自下而上的适应调节在功能上可分离。四元框架为这种分离提供了组织支架，其揭示的角色特异性特征可能为 interpersonal coordination 被破坏的临床人群提供候选生物标志物。

papers.title: High Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) Thalamotomy as a Safe and Effective Treatment of Essential Tremor (ET) in Older Populations and those with Comorbidities
papers.translated_title: 高强度聚焦超声（HIFU）丘脑毁损术作为老年人群及合并症患者特发性震颤（ET）的安全有效治疗方法
papers.author: Farmer, A. J.
papers.summary: Magnetic Resonance guided High Intensity Focused Ultrasound (MRgHIFU) has been demonstrated to be a safe and effective minimally invasive therapy for essential tremor (ET). However, it is not clear whether older adults ([≥]70 years old) or individuals with comorbidities exhibit similar safety and efficacy. This IRB approved project collected EPIC EMR data on patients that underwent MRgHIFU at Parkview Regional Medical Center from January 2023 to November 2025. 68 patients were assessed for tremor severity using Clinical Rating Scale for Tremor (CRST), quality of life using Quality of life in ET Questionnaire (QUEST), and safety profile via reported post-procedure side effects. CRST and QUEST scores improved up to 1 year from baseline in our patient cohort and efficacies in older ([≥]70 years of age) and younger (<70 years of age) patients up to 3 months post MRgHIFU were not statistically different. Effects of comorbidities on CRST or QUEST scores improvements were all transient or did not affect endpoints. Older patients showed fewer total side effects at 3 months (1.17 (95% CI: 0.47-1.87) vs 0.21 (95% CI: -0.09-0.51), p=0.017) as did patients with pulmonary disease at 1 month (1.9 (95% CI: 1.6-2.2) vs 1.1 (95% CI: 0.9-1.3), p=0.036) while patients with family history of tremor showed more side effects at day 1 (1.5 (95% CI: 0.8-2.2) vs 2.5 (95% CI: 2.1-2.9), p=0.025). Age and comorbidities were not detected to adversely affect safety or efficacy following MRgHIFU in ET patients.
papers.translated_summary: 磁共振引导高强度聚焦超声（MRgHIFU）已被证明是治疗特发性震颤（ET）的一种安全有效的微创疗法。然而，老年人（≥70岁）或伴有合并症的患者是否表现出相似的安全性和有效性尚不清楚。本经IRB批准的项目收集了2023年1月至2025年11月在Parkview Regional Medical Center接受MRgHIFU治疗患者的EPIC电子病历数据。采用特发性震颤临床评定量表（CRST）评估68例患者的震颤严重程度，采用特发性震颤生活质量问卷（QUEST）评估生活质量，并通过报告的术后副作用评估安全性特征。在我们的患者队列中，CRST和QUEST评分从基线改善持续至1年，老年（≥70岁）和年轻（<70岁）患者在MRgHIFU术后3个月内的疗效无统计学差异。合并症对CRST或QUEST评分改善的影响均为暂时性的或未影响终点指标。老年患者在3个月时显示较少的副作用总数（1.17（95% CI：0.47-1.87）vs 0.21（95% CI：-0.09-0.51），p=0.017），肺部疾病患者在1个月时同样如此（1.9（95% CI：1.6-2.2）vs 1.1（95% CI：0.9-1.3），p=0.036），而有震颤家族史的患者在第1天显示更多副作用（1.5（95% CI：0.8-2.2）vs 2.5（95% CI：2.1-2.9），p=0.025）。未发现年龄和合并症对ET患者MRgHIFU术后的安全性或有效性产生不良影响。

papers.title: Patient and Surgeon Willingness to Participate in a Randomized Trial of Surgery Versus Observation for Mild Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy: A Cross-Sectional Survey Study
papers.translated_title: 患者与外科医生参与轻度脊髓型颈椎病手术与观察随机试验的意愿：一项横断面调查研究
papers.author: Arkam, F.
papers.summary: BackgroundCervical spondylotic myelopathy (CSM) is the most common cause of nontraumatic spinal cord dysfunction in adults. For mild disease, guidelines recommend shared decision-making between surgery and structured rehabilitation based on clinical equipoise, yet no comparative effectiveness study has reported outcomes in this population. Whether a randomized trial is feasible is unknown. MethodsWe conducted two cross-sectional surveys between December 2025 and July 2026: one of patients with surgeon-confirmed CSM recruited from academic outpatient spine clinics, and one of practicing neurosurgical and orthopedic spine surgeons. Respondents rated willingness to participate in (1) a randomized trial of early surgery versus observation and (2) a prospective observational study in which treatment was patient selected. Responses of likely or very likely were classified as willing. Groups were compared using Fisher exact tests, designs within respondents using exact McNemar tests, and predictors using univariable logistic regression. ResultsFifty-four patients and 52 surgeons completed the surveys. Patients were markedly less willing than surgeons to accept randomization (15 of 54, 27.8% versus 44 of 52, 84.6%; p < 0.001). Both groups accepted the observational design (39 of 54, 72.2% versus 51 of 52, 98.1%; p < 0.001), and 26 of 39 patients unwilling to be randomized were willing to enroll in an observational study (p < 0.001). Willingness to be randomized did not differ across mJOA severity (mild 30.4%, moderate 25.0%, severe 27.3%; p = 0.93). Among patients declining randomization, 85.2% cited a wish to retain control over treatment, whereas fear of surgery was cited by one respondent. Forty-five surgeons (86.5%) considered both surgery and observation reasonable, and preference was divided (46.2% favoring early surgery, 48.1% favoring initial observation). ConclusionsSurgeons report equipoise and high willingness to randomize, but most patients would decline random allocation, citing a wish to retain treatment choice rather than fear or distrust. A prospective observational study appears the more feasible route to comparative evidence in mild CSM. Feasibility assessments restricted to clinicians may substantially overestimate attainable accrual.
papers.translated_summary: 背景颈椎病性脊髓病（CSM）是成人非创伤性脊髓功能障碍最常见的原因。对于轻度疾病，指南建议基于临床均势在手术与结构化康复之间进行共享决策，但目前尚无比较有效性研究报告该人群的结局。随机试验是否可行尚不清楚。方法我们在2025年12月至2026年7月期间开展了两项横断面调查：一项针对从学术门诊脊柱诊所招募的、经外科医生确认的CSM患者，另一项针对执业神经外科和骨科脊柱外科医生。受访者评估了参与以下研究的意愿：（1）早期手术与观察的随机试验；（2）由患者选择治疗的前瞻性观察性研究。回答为可能或非常可能的被归类为有意愿。组间比较采用Fisher精确检验，受访者内部设计比较采用精确McNemar检验，预测因素采用单变量logistic回归。结果54名患者和52名外科医生完成了调查。患者接受随机化的意愿明显低于外科医生（54人中15人，27.8% 对 52人中44人，84.6%；p < 0.001）。两组均接受观察性设计（54人中39人，72.2% 对 52人中51人，98.1%；p < 0.001），且39名不愿被随机化的患者中有26名愿意参加观察性研究（p < 0.001）。接受随机化的意愿在不同mJOA严重程度间无差异（轻度30.4%，中度25.0%，重度27.3%；p = 0.93）。在拒绝随机化的患者中，85.2%提到希望保留对治疗的控制权，而仅有1名受访者提到害怕手术。45名外科医生（86.5%）认为手术和观察均合理，偏好存在分歧（46.2%倾向于早期手术，48.1%倾向于初始观察）。结论外科医生报告存在均势且随机化意愿高，但大多数患者会拒绝随机分配，理由是希望保留治疗选择，而非恐惧或不信任。前瞻性观察性研究似乎是获得轻度CSM比较证据的更可行途径。仅局限于临床医生的可行性评估可能大幅高估可达到的招募量。

papers.title: Benchmarking Recording-Level Clinical Speech De-identification for Privacy-Preserving Clinical Audio
papers.translated_title: 基准测试录音级临床语音去标识化以实现隐私保护临床音频
papers.author: Dai, H.-J.
papers.summary: Transcript-based de-identification protects textual records but leaves sensitive health information (SHI) directly audible in source recordings, limiting trustworthy reuse of clinical audio. However, standardized evaluations of recording-level SHI detection remain limited. We established the SREDH-AICUP 2025 benchmark to evaluate recording-level SHI detection systems and characterize the approaches. All 22 qualifying systems combined automatic speech recognition with downstream SHI detection, whereas we additionally evaluated end-to-end detection from audio. Pipeline baselines outperformed the end-to-end baseline in transcription (MER, 0.123 vs 0.155) and SHI detection (macro-F1, 0.507-0.653 vs 0.422). Synthetic Mandarin speech-text augmentation enabled the end-to-end model to detect Mandarin SHI that was not identified without augmentation (macro-F1, 0.171 vs 0). Foundation models showed category-specific differences in SHI recognition, and type-aware adaptive routing improved macro-F1 from 0.656 to 0.697. These findings establish standardized reference performance, characterize current system designs, and demonstrate how language-specific augmentation and category-aware model integration can improve recording-level SHI detection.
papers.translated_summary: 基于转录文本的去标识化保护了文本记录，但使敏感健康信息（SHI）在源录音中仍可直接被听到，限制了临床音频的可信再利用。然而，针对录音级SHI检测的标准化评估仍然有限。我们建立了SREDH-AICUP 2025基准，以评估录音级SHI检测系统并刻画相关方法。所有22个合格系统均将自动语音识别与下游SHI检测相结合，而我们另外评估了基于音频的端到端检测。流水线基线在转录（MER，0.123 vs 0.155）和SHI检测（宏F1，0.507-0.653 vs 0.422）上均优于端到端基线。合成普通话语音-文本增强使端到端模型能够检测到未增强时无法识别的普通话SHI（宏F1，0.171 vs 0）。基础模型在SHI识别上表现出类别特异性差异，类型感知的自适应路由将宏F1从0.656提升至0.697。这些发现建立了标准化参考性能，刻画了当前系统设计，并展示了语言特异性增强与类别感知模型集成如何改进录音级SHI检测。

papers.title: BanglaDiaHallu: Hallucinations of large language models and the effect of guideline-grounded retrieval-augmented generation in Bangla diabetes question answering
papers.translated_title: BanglaDiaHallu：大型语言模型的幻觉以及基于指南的检索增强生成在孟加拉语糖尿病问答中的效果
papers.author: Nahid, K. H.
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted for health advice, but they can produce fluent statements that are false or unsupported, known as hallucinations, and this risk is poorly characterised in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We measured hallucinations of locally deployable open-weight LLMs in Bangla diabetes question answering and tested whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounded in Bangladeshs National Guideline on Diabetes Mellitus reduces them. Forty patient questions spanning six clinical sub-domains were each answered twice, under zero-shot prompting, by Qwen3.5-9B, TigerLLM-9B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, and by BanglaDiaRAG, which adds hybrid dense (BGE-M3) and sparse (BM25) retrieval from a physician-reviewed Bangla guideline knowledge base to Qwen3.5-9B. Two physicians rated the 400 de-identified responses by consensus for medical accuracy, completeness, safety, readability and reliability on a 0-1 scale, and responses with accuracy below 0.70 were classified as hallucinated. Hallucination rates were 2.5% for Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3.8% for TigerLLM-9B, 22.5% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and 77.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Guideline grounding lowered the rate of Qwen3.5-9B to 11.3% (difference -66.3 percentage points; 95% CI -76.3 to -55.0) and raised every criterion by 0.24 to 0.38 points (Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). BanglaDiaRAG outscored Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on all five criteria and matched or exceeded TigerLLM-9B, but it remained below Gemma-4-26B-A4B in safety, readability and reliability, and its residual errors were specific, confident and potentially harmful. Guideline grounding can turn a weak general-purpose model into a much safer Bangla diabetes assistant, but the choice of base model mattered as much as retrieval and no configuration was free of hallucination, so clinical oversight remains essential before patient-facing use.
papers.translated_summary: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于获取健康建议，但它们可能生成流畅却虚假或无依据的陈述，即幻觉，而这种风险在孟加拉语等低资源语言中尚缺乏充分刻画。我们测量了可本地部署的开放权重LLM在孟加拉语糖尿病问答中的幻觉情况，并检验了以孟加拉国《糖尿病国家指南》为基础的检索增强生成（RAG）是否能减少幻觉。40个涵盖六个临床子域的患者问题，在零样本提示下，分别由Qwen3.5-9B、TigerLLM-9B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B各回答两次，并由BanglaDiaRAG回答，后者在Qwen3.5-9B基础上加入了来自经医师审核的孟加拉语指南知识库的混合稠密（BGE-M3）与稀疏（BM25）检索。两名医师对400份去标识化回答以共识方式按0-1量表评定医学准确性、完整性、安全性、可读性和可靠性，准确性低于0.70的回答被归类为幻觉。幻觉率分别为Gemma-4-26B-A4B 2.5%、TigerLLM-9B 3.8%、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 22.5%和Qwen3.5-9B 77.5%。指南 grounding 将Qwen3.5-9B的幻觉率降至11.3%（差值-66.3个百分点；95% CI -76.3至-55.0），并使每项标准提高0.24至0.38分（Holm校正p < 0.001）。BanglaDiaRAG在全部五项标准上均优于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，并与TigerLLM-9B持平或超过后者，但在安全性、可读性和可靠性上仍低于Gemma-4-26B-A4B，且其残余错误具体、自信且可能有害。指南 grounding 可将一个较弱的通用模型转变为安全得多的孟加拉语糖尿病助手，但基础模型的选择与检索同样重要，且没有任何配置完全无幻觉，因此在面向患者使用前临床监督仍必不可少。

papers.title: Trends in incidence and antimicrobial resistance for five major causes of bacteraemia in a Canadian metropolitan area, 2006-22: a genomic and antimicrobial use cohort study
papers.translated_title: 2006-22年加拿大某大都市区五种主要菌血症病因的发病率和抗菌药物耐药性趋势：一项基因组和抗菌药物使用队列研究
papers.author: Pham, T. M.
papers.summary: Background Using a population-based cohort from the Calgary Health Zone (CHZ), Canada, we integrated longitudinal antimicrobial susceptibility and prescribing data with the whole genome sequences of five major pathogens. We aimed to assess how antimicrobial resistance (AMR) responds to prescribing changes and determine which bacterial strains shape these dynamics. Methods We analysed antibiotic prescribing rates, clinical and genomic data from 7,271 Staphylococcus aureus, 1,609 Enterococcus faecalis, 801 Enterococcus faecium, 11,363 Escherichia coli, and 2,319 Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, associated with bacteraemia episodes in the CHZ between 2006-2022. Genomic clusters (referred to as strains) were identified using StrainGST and assigned to known sequence types (STs) or clonal complexes (CCs). Strain-level incidence, stratified by community-onset (isolates collected [≤]48h after admission) and hospital-onset (>48h after admission), AMR phenotypes, and prescribing rates were modelled using negative-binomial and binomial regression. Temporal trends were quantified using average annual percentage change (AAPC). Findings Between 2010-2022, fluoroquinolone prescribing declined in both community (AAPC=-6.8% [95% CI -8.1, -5.4]; p<0.0001) and hospital settings (AAPC=-5.1% [-6.5, -3.7]; p<0.0001). This was accompanied by a significant reduction in fluoroquinolone resistance among Gram-positive species. Specifically, S aureus bacteraemia resistant to clinically important antibiotics, cloxacillin, ciprofloxacin, erythromycin, and clindamycin, declined from 2006 to 2022, mostly in hospital-onset cases (AAPC=-16.0%, [-19.3%, -12.7%], p<0.0001). In E coli, ceftriaxone and ciprofloxacin resistance were clustered in ST131 and the emerging ST1193; the latter increased steadily, particularly in community-onset cases (AAPC=17.7%, [9.0%, 30.0%], p<0.0001). CTX-M-27-producing E coli ST131 strains increased (AAPC=23.8%, [17.4%, 30.5%], p<0.0001) between 2008-2022, while CTX-M-14-producing E coli ST131 declined (AAPC=-15.9%, [-21.3%, -10.2%], p<0.0001) between 2013-2022. These trends were paralleled by an increase in community cephalosporin prescribing (AAPC=7.3%, [4.2%, 10.5%], p<0.0001) between 2010-2022. For K pneumoniae, hypervirulent ST23 was most common (N=88) with an increasing trend in incidence (AAPC=2.3%, [-4.4%, 9.4%]) between 2006-2019. Conclusions The contrasting resistance trends between Gram-positive and Gram-negative species underscore the complexity of AMR control efforts. Effective strategies will require stewardship efforts targeting multiple drug classes, genomic surveillance for emerging resistant strains, and interventions extending beyond hospital settings. Funding This study was funded by a Large Scale Applied Research Project competition award (2017) from Genome Canada, administered via Genome Alberta. IAL is supported by an Alberta Innovates Translational Health Chair and a UCalgary Research Excellence Chair, with additional support from the Canada Foundation for Innovation (CFI-JELF 34986), the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council (DG 04547). Microbial isolates were prepared for analysis at the Alberta Centre for Advanced Diagnostics, which is supported by PrairiesCan (000022734). This work was also supported by federal funds from the US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, National Institutes of Health, Department of Health and Human Services, under grant number U19AI110818 to the Broad Institute. JTS is additionally supported by the NIH/NIAID F32AI179151.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 利用加拿大卡尔加里卫生区（CHZ）的基于人群队列，我们将纵向抗菌药物敏感性及处方数据与五种主要病原体的全基因组序列进行整合。旨在评估抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）如何响应处方变化，并确定哪些细菌菌株塑造了这些动态。方法 我们分析了2006-2022年间CHZ地区与菌血症发作相关的7,271株金黄色葡萄球菌、1,609株粪肠球菌、801株屎肠球菌、11,363株大肠埃希菌和2,319株肺炎克雷伯菌分离株的抗生素处方率、临床及基因组数据。使用StrainGST鉴定基因组簇（称为菌株），并将其分配至已知序列型（STs）或克隆复合体（CCs）。按社区发病（入院后≤48小时采集的分离株）和医院发病（入院后>48小时）分层，使用负二项和二项回归对菌株水平发病率、AMR表型和处方率进行建模。使用平均年度百分比变化（AAPC）量化时间趋势。结果 2010-2022年间，氟喹诺酮类处方在社区（AAPC=-6.8% [95% CI -8.1, -5.4]；p<0.0001）和医院环境（AAPC=-5.1% [-6.5, -3.7]；p<0.0001）均下降。与此同时，革兰阳性菌种的氟喹诺酮类耐药性显著降低。具体而言，对临床重要抗生素（氯唑西林、环丙沙星、红霉素和克林霉素）耐药的金黄色葡萄球菌菌血症从2006年至2022年下降，主要见于医院发病病例（AAPC=-16.0%，[-19.3%，-12.7%]，p<0.0001）。在大肠埃希菌中，头孢曲松和环丙沙星耐药性聚集于ST131和新出现的ST1193；后者稳步增加，尤其在社区发病病例中（AAPC=17.7%，[9.0%，30.0%]，p<0.0001）。产CTX-M-27的大肠埃希菌ST131菌株在2008-2022年间增加（AAPC=23.8%，[17.4%，30.5%]，p<0.0001），而产CTX-M-14的大肠埃希菌ST131在2013-2022年间下降（AAPC=-15.9%，[-21.3%，-10.2%]，p<0.0001）。这些趋势与2010-2022年间社区头孢菌素处方增加（AAPC=7.3%，[4.2%，10.5%]，p<0.0001）相平行。对于肺炎克雷伯菌，高毒力ST23最为常见（N=88），2006-2019年间发病率呈上升趋势（AAPC=2.3%，[-4.4%，9.4%]）。结论 革兰阳性与革兰阴性菌种之间相反的耐药趋势凸显了AMR控制工作的复杂性。有效策略需要针对多类药物类别的管理措施、对新出现耐药菌株的基因组监测以及超越医院环境的干预措施。资助 本研究由Genome Canada于2017年颁发的大规模应用研究项目竞赛奖资助，通过Genome Alberta管理。IAL获得Alberta Innovates转化健康讲席和UCalgary研究卓越讲席的支持，并获得加拿大创新基金会（CFI-JELF 34986）和自然科学与工程研究理事会（DG 04547）的额外支持。微生物分离株在Alberta先进诊断中心制备用于分析，该中心由PrairiesCan（000022734）支持。本工作还得到美国国立卫生研究院国家过敏和传染病研究所的联邦资金支持，隶属于卫生与公众服务部，授予Broad研究所的资助编号为U19AI110818。JTS还获得NIH/NIAID F32AI179151的额外支持。

papers.title: Interpreting variants associated with congenital heart disease with a regulatory map of the human fetal heart
papers.translated_title: 用人类胎儿心脏调控图谱解读与先天性心脏病相关的变异
papers.author: Ma, X. R.
papers.summary: Congenital heart defects (CHD) arise in part due to inherited genetic variants that alter genes and noncoding regulatory elements in the human genome. These variants are thought to act during fetal development to influence the formation of different heart structures. However, identifying the genes, pathways, and cell types that mediate these effects has been challenging due to the diversity of cell types involved in heart development as well as the superimposed complexities of interpreting noncoding sequences. As such, understanding the molecular functions of both noncoding and coding variants remains paramount to our fundamental understanding of cardiac development and CHD. Here, we created a gene regulation map of the healthy human fetal heart across developmental time and applied it to interpret the functions of variants associated with CHD and quantitative cardiac traits. We collected multiomic data from 734,078 single cells sampled from 41 fetal hearts spanning post-conception weeks (PCW) 6 to 22, enabling the construction of gene regulation maps in 90 cardiac cell types and states, including rare populations of cardiac conduction system (CCS) cell types. We find that many such risk variants, both coding and noncoding, map onto gene regulatory networks in valve cells. In an unbiased analysis of 90 cardiac cell types and states, valvular interstitial cells (VICs) show the strongest enrichments for known CHD genes. Nine CHD genes are linked to common noncoding variants associated with other valve diseases or traits via transcriptional enhancers in VICs. CRISPRi experiments show that multiple CHD genes have cell-autonomous effects in VICs, including regulating the expression of other CHD genes and genes involved in cell migration and developmental patterning. Finally, we characterize a CHD-associated noncoding variant whose activity is specific to discrete structures within the heart, illuminating how such variants can impact specific aspects of heart structure and function. Together, these results suggest that genetic risk for many subtypes of CHD is influenced in part by genetic regulation of valvular cells, expanding our understanding of the cell types responsible for CHD beyond the working cardiomyocyte. This regulatory map of the human fetal heart provides a foundational resource for understanding cardiac development, interpreting genetic variants associated with heart disease, and discovering targets for cell-type specific therapies.
papers.translated_summary: 先天性心脏缺陷(CHD)部分源于改变人类基因组中基因和非编码调控元件的遗传变异。这些变异被认为在胎儿发育期间发挥作用，影响不同心脏结构的形成。然而，由于心脏发育涉及多种细胞类型，以及解读非编码序列的叠加复杂性，识别介导这些效应的基因、通路和细胞类型一直具有挑战性。因此，理解非编码和编码变异的分子功能对于我们对心脏发育和CHD的基本认识仍然至关重要。在此，我们构建了健康人类胎儿心脏跨发育时间的基因调控图谱，并将其应用于解读与CHD和定量心脏性状相关的变异功能。我们从41个胎儿心脏中采集了734,078个单细胞的多组学数据，样本涵盖受孕后第6至22周(PCW)，从而能够在90种心脏细胞类型和状态中构建基因调控图谱，包括心脏传导系统(CCS)细胞类型的稀有群体。我们发现，许多此类风险变异，无论是编码还是非编码的，都映射到瓣膜细胞的基因调控网络上。在对90种心脏细胞类型和状态的无偏分析中，瓣膜间质细胞(VICs)显示出对已知CHD基因最强的富集。九个CHD基因通过VICs中的转录增强子与与其他瓣膜疾病或性状相关的常见非编码变异相关联。CRISPRi实验表明，多个CHD基因在VICs中具有细胞自主效应，包括调控其他CHD基因以及参与细胞迁移和发育模式化的基因的表达。最后，我们表征了一个CHD相关的非编码变异，其活性对心脏内离散结构具有特异性，揭示了此类变异如何影响心脏结构和功能的特定方面。总之，这些结果表明，许多CHD亚型的遗传风险部分受到瓣膜细胞遗传调控的影响，将我们对导致CHD的细胞类型的理解扩展到工作心肌细胞之外。这份人类胎儿心脏调控图谱为理解心脏发育、解读与心脏病相关的遗传变异以及发现细胞类型特异性治疗的靶点提供了基础资源。

papers.title: A prospective, comparative cohort analysis of influenza antibody waning in Michigan and Hong Kong during periods of low influenza circulation
papers.translated_title: 在流感低流行期间，密歇根和香港流感抗体衰减的前瞻性比较队列分析
papers.author: Yang, Y.
papers.summary: Background: Reduced influenza transmission during the COVID-19 pandemic prompted concern about waning of population immunity that could lead to subsequent surges in circulation. We compared longitudinal influenza antibody titers in Michigan and Hong Kong, two regions with reduced influenza transmission during the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods: In two prospective cohort studies (HIVE, Michigan; EPI-HK, Hong Kong), we analyzed longitudinal serum samples collected from 2020 through 2023 from participants without influenza infection or vaccination. Sera were tested using hemagglutination inhibition assays (HAI) and microneutralization (MN) against vaccine strains. Two-year fold changes in titers were estimated using multivariable power-law models adjusted for age and baseline titer. Results: We analyzed 173 sera from 57 HIVE participants and 259 sera from 60 EPI-HK participants. Initial HAI geometric mean titers ranged from 12.3-123.4 in HIVE and 6.3-40.9 in EPI-HK. Among those with >1:40 baseline titers in HIVE, fold-change estimates indicated waning for H1N1 strains, including A/Brisbane (0.70 [95% CI: 0.56,0.86]), A/Idaho (0.40 [0.32,0.50]), and A/Michigan (0.43 [0.34,0.52]), while H3N2 and influenza B showed minimal or no waning. In EPI-HK, fold-change estimates demonstrated heterogeneous patterns by strain for H1N1, and waning for selected H3N2 strains, including A/Cambodia (0.44 [0.29,0.65]) and A/Singapore (0.48 [0.33,0.69]). MN results were consistent with HAI findings. Conclusion: Influenza antibody responses during the pandemic showed heterogeneous, strain-specific changes rather than uniform decline. These findings suggest that population immunity was maintained for many strains despite reduced viral circulation, with waning occurring in particular strains and varying by population.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：COVID-19大流行期间流感传播减少，引发了人们对人群免疫力下降可能导致随后流感传播激增的担忧。我们比较了密歇根和香港两个在COVID-19大流行期间流感传播减少地区的纵向流感抗体滴度。方法：在两项前瞻性队列研究（HIVE，密歇根；EPI-HK，香港）中，我们分析了2020年至2023年从无流感感染或疫苗接种的参与者中收集的纵向血清样本。使用血凝抑制试验（HAI）和微量中和试验（MN）针对疫苗株检测血清。使用针对年龄和基线滴度调整的多变量幂律模型估计滴度的两年倍数变化。结果：我们分析了来自57名HIVE参与者的173份血清和来自60名EPI-HK参与者的259份血清。HIVE的初始HAI几何平均滴度范围为12.3-123.4，EPI-HK为6.3-40.9。在HIVE中基线滴度>1:40的参与者中，倍数变化估计表明H1N1毒株出现下降，包括A/Brisbane（0.70 [95% CI: 0.56,0.86]）、A/Idaho（0.40 [0.32,0.50]）和A/Michigan（0.43 [0.34,0.52]），而H3N2和乙型流感显示最小或无下降。在EPI-HK中，倍数变化估计显示H1N1按毒株呈现异质性模式，以及选定的H3N2毒株出现下降，包括A/Cambodia（0.44 [0.29,0.65]）和A/Singapore（0.48 [0.33,0.69]）。MN结果与HAI发现一致。结论：大流行期间的流感抗体反应显示异质性、毒株特异性变化，而非均匀下降。这些发现表明，尽管病毒传播减少，许多毒株的人群免疫力得以维持，特定毒株出现下降且因人群而异。

papers.title: Resistance Training Frequency and Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Volume-Equated Trials
papers.translated_title: 抗阻训练频率与肌肉肥大：容量等同试验的系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Boutagy, A. G.
papers.summary: Weekly training volume is the primary driver of resistance-training hypertrophy, but the independent role of frequency can be isolated only when weekly volume is equated. We quantified the effect of training frequency on hypertrophy across one to three volume-equated sessions per muscle per week. Following PRISMA 2020, five databases were searched to October 2026 for trials of at least six weeks that equated weekly volume between per-muscle frequencies and measured muscle size. One change-score standardized mean difference per trial (Hedges g; negative favoring higher frequency) was pooled with a random-effects model, and certainty was rated with GRADE. Sixteen trials (380 participants) were pooled. The frequency effect was trivial and non-significant (g = -0.02; 95% CI -0.21 to 0.16; I{superscript 2} = 0%; prediction interval -0.23 to 0.18); the interval admits at most a small effect favoring the higher frequency. Contrast-specific estimates were similarly trivial, and no moderator was significant, although the moderator analyses could detect only large effects. Certainty was low to very low. Within this range, the data give no basis for preferring one, two or three sessions at a fixed weekly volume. Most trials measured muscle thickness, which does not track whole-muscle growth reliably.
papers.translated_summary: 每周训练量是抗阻训练诱导肌肥大的主要驱动因素，但只有在周训练量相等时，才能分离出训练频率的独立作用。我们量化了每块肌肉每周一至三次训练量相等 sessions 对肌肥大的频率效应。遵循 PRISMA 2020，检索了五个数据库至2026年10月，纳入至少六周、在每块肌肉训练频率之间均衡周训练量并测量肌肉大小的试验。每项试验的一个变化分数标准化均数差（Hedges g；负值有利于较高频率）采用随机效应模型合并，并用 GRADE 评定证据确定性。共合并16项试验（380名参与者）。频率效应微不足道且不显著（g = -0.02；95% CI -0.21至0.16；I{superscript 2} = 0%；预测区间 -0.23至0.18）；该区间最多允许有利于较高频率的小效应。对比特异性估计同样微不足道，且无显著调节因素，尽管调节因素分析仅能检测到大效应。证据确定性为低至极低。在此范围内，数据没有提供依据在固定周训练量下偏好一次、两次或三次 sessions。大多数试验测量肌肉厚度，而肌肉厚度不能可靠反映整块肌肉的生长。
